summary: Old Doe, Johnson County TN: a Tennessee lookout inventory lists it at 3,694 ft as removed; no build, staffing or site history found.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed in the tnlandforms.us Tennessee lookout inventory; no source read describes the site now.

sources.title: Kettlefoot Fire Lookout Tower at Doe Mountain

notes_for_editor: Single inventory row (tnlandforms.us, JOT004: Old Doe, 3694 ft, Johnson, '1-1 removed') plus Clio's county context. The inventory does not define 'removed'; the record's gone status rests on it. No build date, builder, height, staffing, fire, or access record was found in two web searches and the pages read. The Tennessee Division of Forestry site returned HTTP 403 and was not read. The 2015 multiple-property study 'Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers, 1933-1975' is named in search snippets but was not opened; it may hold tower histories. Name confusion: the Kettlefoot NRHP nomination gives its other name as 'Doe Mountain Fire Lookout Tower', and visitors searching 'Doe' may land on Kettlefoot. The record's coordinates (36.399, -81.9471) come from the tnlandforms map and were not checked against Kettlefoot's position. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
